+# bro-real-goal-validation
+
+Two small, independent ES modules (Node.js, no dependencies):
+
+| Module         | Export                       |
+| -------------- | ---------------------------- |
+| `numbers.mjs`  | `sumIntegers(input)`         |
+| `text.mjs`     | `normalizeWhitespace(input)` |
+
+The project is `"type": "module"`, so both files are imported with standard ESM `import`.
+
+## `sumIntegers(input)` — `numbers.mjs`
+
+Sums a comma-separated list of signed integers and returns a `number`.
+
+### Input rules
+
+- `input` must be a string.
+- The string is split on `,`; whitespace around each token is trimmed.
+- Each token must match `^[+-]?\d+$`: an optional `+`/`-` sign followed by ASCII digits only.
+- Each token's value must be a safe integer (`Number.isSafeInteger`, i.e. within ±9007199254740991).
+- The running sum is checked after every addition and must stay a safe integer.
+
+### Rejection behavior
+
+`sumIntegers` throws (it never returns `NaN` or a partial result):
+
+| Input                          | Reason                         | Error        |
+| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------ | ------------ |
+| non-string (e.g. `42`, `null`) | not a string                   | `TypeError`  |
+| `''`, `'   '`                  | empty / whitespace-only input  | `RangeError` |
+| `'1,,2'`, `'1,'`               | empty token                    | `RangeError` |
+| `'1.5'`, `'1e3'`               | fraction / exponent            | `RangeError` |
+| `'oops'`, `'0x10'`             | not a number                   | `RangeError` |
+| `'9007199254740992'`           | unsafe integer                 | `RangeError` |
+| `'9007199254740991,1'`         | sum leaves the safe range      | `RangeError` |
+
+Because the sum is checked at every step, `'9007199254740991,1,-1'` is also rejected, even though its final total would be safe.
+
+### Examples
+
+```js
+import { sumIntegers } from './numbers.mjs';
+
+sumIntegers('2,-5,1');           // -2
+sumIntegers(' 10 , -2 , 3 ');    // 11
+sumIntegers('+7');               // 7
+
+sumIntegers('');                 // throws RangeError
+sumIntegers('1,,2');             // throws RangeError
+sumIntegers('1.5');              // throws RangeError
+sumIntegers('oops');             // throws RangeError
+sumIntegers('9007199254740992'); // throws RangeError (unsafe integer)
+```
+
+## `normalizeWhitespace(input)` — `text.mjs`
+
+Turns every run of whitespace into a single ASCII space (U+0020), then trims both ends.
+
+### Behavior
+
+- `input` must be a string; anything else throws a `TypeError`.
+- Whitespace is matched with the JavaScript `\s` class (with the `u` flag). This covers ASCII whitespace (tab, LF, VT, FF, CR, space), line/paragraph separators (U+2028, U+2029), U+FEFF, and every Unicode `Zs` space separator, including NO-BREAK SPACE U+00A0, U+2000–U+200A (e.g. EM SPACE U+2003) and IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE U+3000.
+- Characters outside that class are not whitespace here and stay as they are, for example ZERO WIDTH SPACE U+200B and NEXT LINE U+0085.
+- Letter case is never changed, and non-ASCII letters (e.g. `ß`, `東京`) pass through unchanged. No case folding or Unicode normalization is done.
+- An empty or whitespace-only string becomes `''`.
+
+### Examples
+
+The non-ASCII space characters are built with `String.fromCodePoint` so the examples are unambiguous.
+
+```js
+import { normalizeWhitespace } from './text.mjs';
+
+const NBSP = String.fromCodePoint(0x00a0); // NO-BREAK SPACE
+const EMSP = String.fromCodePoint(0x2003); // EM SPACE
+const IDSP = String.fromCodePoint(0x3000); // IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE
+
+normalizeWhitespace('  A\tB\nC  ');                     // 'A B C'
+normalizeWhitespace(`${NBSP}Straße${EMSP}東京${NBSP}`); // 'Straße 東京'
+normalizeWhitespace(`Hello${IDSP}${IDSP}World`);        // 'Hello World'
+normalizeWhitespace('MiXeD   Case');                    // 'MiXeD Case'
+normalizeWhitespace('');                                // ''
+normalizeWhitespace(' \t\n ');                          // ''
+
+normalizeWhitespace(42);                                // throws TypeError
+```
+
+## Testing
+
+The contracts are in `tests/numbers.test.mjs` and `tests/text.test.mjs` and use Node's built-in `node:test` runner. Run them with:
+
+```sh
+npm test
+```
+
+This runs `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`. Each contract is reported as TODO only when its module file is missing. With both `numbers.mjs` and `text.mjs` present, both contracts run in full and are expected to pass with no TODO and no skipped tests.

+/**
+ * Sum comma-separated signed safe integers.
+ *
+ * Each token is trimmed of surrounding whitespace. Throws on:
+ *  - non-string or empty/whitespace-only input
+ *  - empty tokens (e.g. "1,,2" or trailing comma)
+ *  - fractions, exponents, non-numeric tokens
+ *  - integers outside the safe integer range
+ *  - sums (including intermediate sums) outside the safe integer range
+ *
+ * @param {string} input
+ * @returns {number}
+ */
+export function sumIntegers(input) {
+  if (typeof input !== 'string') {
+    throw new TypeError('sumIntegers: input must be a string');
+  }
+  if (input.trim() === '') {
+    throw new RangeError('sumIntegers: input must not be empty');
+  }
+  const INTEGER = /^[+-]?\d+$/;
+  let total = 0;
+  for (const raw of input.split(',')) {
+    const token = raw.trim();
+    if (token === '') {
+      throw new RangeError('sumIntegers: empty token');
+    }
+    if (!INTEGER.test(token)) {
+      throw new RangeError(`sumIntegers: not an integer: ${JSON.stringify(token)}`);
+    }
+    const value = Number(token);
+    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) {
+      throw new RangeError(`sumIntegers: unsafe integer: ${token}`);
+    }
+    total += value;
+    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total)) {
+      throw new RangeError('sumIntegers: sum exceeds safe integer range');
+    }
+  }
+  return total;
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+// BRO_TEXT_CHANGE_ADOPTED_R16
+/**
+ * Trim and collapse runs of Unicode whitespace to a single ASCII space.
+ * Letter case and non-ASCII letters are preserved unchanged.
+ * @param {string} input
+ * @returns {string}
+ */
+export function normalizeWhitespace(input) {
+  if (typeof input !== 'string') {
+    throw new TypeError('normalizeWhitespace expects a string');
+  }
+  // JS \s matches Unicode whitespace (incl. U+00A0, U+2000–U+200A, U+3000, U+FEFF).
+  return input.replace(/\s+/gu, ' ').trim();
+}
